figures.caption: FIGURE 1 Dry-process fabrication of USF. (a) Schematic illustration of the hot-rolling dry process used to fabricate the USF. (b) Top-view SEM image of USF. (c) Cross-sectional SEM image and corresponding EDS elemental mapping of USF. (d) Comparison of the thickness of sulfide electrolyte films fabricated by dry processing. The corresponding references are listed in Table S1. (e, f) The MIP analysis of LPSCl-PTFE precursor film and USF: (e) apparent pore-size distributions and (f) apparent porosity comparison. (g) Load-depth curves of LPSCl pellet, LPSCl-PTFE precursor film and USF. (h) Hardness and indentation modulus calculated from load-depth curves. (i) Work of indentation and dissipation, and average dissipation efficiency calculated from the load-depth curves.

figures.caption: FIGURE 2 Li+ transport behavior and mechanism in the USF. (a) Arrhenius plots of pristine LPSCl (Ea = 0.24 eV), LPSCl-PTFE film (Ea = 0.32 eV), LPSCl-LiTFSI-PMEMA film (Ea = 0.28 eV), and USF (Ea = 0.29 eV). figures.caption: FIGURE 3 Interfacial stability and Li deposition behavior in LiIn||SE||LiIn symmetric cells. (a) CCD test of the LiIn||LPSCl-PTFE||LiIn cell (CCD = 0.9 mA cm‒2). (b) CCD test of the LiIn||USF||LiIn cell (CCD = 2.2 mA cm‒2). (d, e) Cross-sectional SEM images of the LiIn/SSEs interface after 200 h of cycling: (d) LiIn||LPSCl-PTFE||LiIn cell, and (e) LiIn||USF||LiIn cell. (f, g) The corresponding schematic illustrations of Li deposition behavior: (f) LiIn||LPSCl-PTFE||LiIn cell, and (g) LiIn||USF||LiIn cell.

Voltage-dependent in-situ EIS and DRT analysis of the NCM721||USF||nSi full cell after 10 cycles. a) Charge/discharge voltage profile with marked EIS measurement points. b) Nyquist plots collected at selected voltages during charge and discharge. The spectra are vertically offset for clarity. c) Corresponding DRT spectra derived from the voltage- dependent EIS data.
